verdict.rationale: Stripe documents verification for '120+ countries' with document authenticity checks, selfie matching, SSN and national ID validation (stripe-identity-docs-1, stripe-identity-docs-3, stripe-identity-docs-14), but no granular published list breaking down supported document types per country is evidenced. Community reports concrete failures — Polish IDs unsupported, Chinese passports rejected as 'invalid', and APAC passport validation issues described as a 'Schrodinger's paradox' — directly contradicting the breadth claim (stripe-identity-comm-6, stripe-identity-comm-12, stripe-identity-comm-13). Missing for 10: an actual published per-country/per-document-type coverage table, and resolution of the documented failure reports for specific nationalities/documents.
